decisions.reason: As a finned tube for air coolers, this product is closely tied to the firm's existing heat-exchanger manufacturing knowledge, so under an absorptive-capacity view the firm is likely able to learn from early market feedback and improve it rather than withdraw it.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build even more directly on the firm's established technical base and process know-how, making commercial adaptation and incremental R&D relatively feasible and reducing the likelihood of near-term withdrawal.
